public_rationale: This forecast applies only if OpenAI cannot meet its obligations. Searches up to October 28, 2026 found doubts about OpenAI's ability to pay, but no report of a default, missed payment or forced renegotiation. Since the condition has not been shown to happen, the forecast about Nvidia and Oracle cannot be scored.
limitations: Without a documented failure, falling Oracle or Nvidia stock cannot be counted, because the forecast is about damage caused by an OpenAI failure.
Some obligations come due only from 2027.

Outcome: Nvidia, Oracle and other counterparties suffer large stock declines or financial losses that are clearly tied to that failure.
